description: Verify that a service is identified by its Service-ID — DUT emits OfferService and replies to a Method Request with a matching Response (SOME/IP §5.1.4)
approach:
[Objective]
The baseline check that DUT can play a SOME/IP server role: it advertises the service via OfferService and answers method calls. Anchors all other §5.1.4 / §5.1.5 cases.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. DUT (UT-driven) starts service → DUT → Tester: OfferService (multicast SD on port 30490).
2. Tester → DUT: Method Request to the offered service.
3. Observation: DUT → Tester: Method Response.

[Pass condition]
Both OfferService and matching Method Response observed.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_phase1_no_offer — no OfferService
• Fail_phase2_no_response — no Method Response

verdicts.Pass: DUT offered service and replied to method request — normal
verdicts.Fail_phase2_no_response: No Method Response within listen window
